title: edit-site-profile command payload

siteProfileId.description: Present when the host already has a profile; must match the host.

baseVersion.description: Optimistic check: the number of the applied version the edit is based on; null when the host has none. A mismatch fails the command (site_profile.version_conflict).

presetId.description: The built-in CMS preset the profile starts from (SiteProfiles.PresetId).

cms.description: The CMS fingerprint, e.g. sitevision; selects the built-in preset that seeded the fields.

mainRoot.description: CSS selector of the main-content root (Sitevision: main); fallback landmarks main, article, role=main.

selectors.description: CSS selectors of blocks removed inside the root.

phrases.description: Exact phrases removed inside the root (after whitespace normalisation).

boilerplate.description: Blocks and phrases inside the root that are stripped (share widgets, short-URL lines).

linkBlocks.description: CSS selectors of link lists inside the root (umea.se: Undersidor) kept for link discovery, never as chunk text.

breadcrumb.description: CSS selector of the breadcrumb; absent = aria-label Brödsmulor/breadcrumb, then BreadcrumbList.

datePattern.description: .NET regular expression of the visible date with a group named d (YYYY-MM-DD), e.g. Sidan uppdaterades (?<d>\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}).

pattern.description: .NET regular expression over the URL path, e.g. ^/(?:.*/)?[^/]*?\.?(?<id>\d+\.[0-9a-f]+)\.html$ for Sitevision node ids.

replacement.description: The identity path, with ${name} for named groups, e.g. /${id}.html.

verified.description: True once id-only URLs returned the same content hash as the full URLs on sampled pages; an unverified rule is not applied.

identityRule.description: Maps a URL path to its stable identity (connectors design §3.1 rule 10); used only when verified.

ignoreQueryParams.description: Session and noise query parameters of the host, dropped by the canonicaliser (connectors design §3.1 rule 7); case-insensitive, a trailing * is a prefix (sv.*).

excludedTypes.description: Media-type patterns not admitted to the crawl (connectors design §5.2).

lastmodReliable.description: Changed by hand only from the recorded 500-URL lastmod sample (to-verify #170); until then false and the host gets full traversals.

decidedBy.description: The deciding platform admin's oid, written to SiteProfileVersions.CreatedBy and AppliedBy; absent = system:worker.

minBuild.description: The oldest worker build that may run the job; an older instance requeues it without an attempt (engine design §9.1).

traceparent.description: traceparent of the job that enqueued this continuation; the job's span links to it (engine design §17).

description: Payload of the command edit-site-profile (connectors design §5.6): the profile becomes a new manual version of the host's site profile at the job's level and is applied. Dedup site-profile:{siteProfileId}, or site-profile:{level}:{host} for a host without a profile.
